players.bio: Alejandro Alvarado Jr. (born July 29, 2003) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC.

Alexander Cole Mighten (born 11 April 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC. Born in the United States, he represented England at youth international level. Mighten joined Nottingham Forest from Arnold Town in 2009 and made his professional debut in September 2019.

Amahl William D'vaz Pellegrino (born 18 June 1990) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a left winger or forward for Major League Soccer club San Diego. Club career Early career Pellegrino started his career in Drammen FK, before moving to Bærum SK at the age of 22. Bærum played in the 2012 Norwegian First Division, was relegated that year, but won promotion again in 2013.

Anders Laustrup Dreyer (Danish pronunciation: ; born 2 May 1998) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC. Dreyer previously played for Esbjerg fB, Brighton & Hove Albion, St Mirren, SC Heerenveen, Midtjylland, Rubin Kazan and Anderlecht.

Anibal Casis Godoy Lemus (born 10 February 1990) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC and captains the Panama national team.

Bi Voli Bryan Christian Zamblé is an 18-year-old Ivorian professional football player who plays as a left winger and forward for Major League Soccer (MLS) club San Diego FC. Born in Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire, on 19 February 2008, the 1.71-metre-tall attacker signed with the expansion MLS franchise in February 2026 on a guaranteed contract through the 2026 season, with club options extending to 2030.

Bryce Michael Duke (born February 28, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC. Career Duke was born in Casa Grande, Arizona, where he initially played youth soccer for CCV Stars. Following a trial in 2015, Duke was a part of the Real Salt Lake academy from 2016 to 2018 before joining the Barca Residency Academy.

Cédric Bakambu (born 11 April 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward or a winger for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC and the DR Congo national team. Bakambu made his professional debut for Sochaux in 2010, and played 107 official games for them over five seasons, scoring 21 goals.
Christopher Donald McVey (born 12 April 1997) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC.

Carlos Joaquim "CJ" Antunes dos Santos (born 24 August 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC. Born in the United States, he has committed to represent Cape Verde internationally.

Mohamed Elias Achouri (Arabic: مُحَمَّد إِلْيَاس عَاشُورِيّ; born 10 February 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Danish Superliga side Copenhagen. Born in France, Achouri plays for the Tunisia national team. On 26 August 2021, Achouri joined Liga Portugal 2 club Trofense on loan from Estoril.

Emmanuel Agyenim "Ema" Boateng (born 17 January 1994) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC. Early life and education Boateng was born and raised in Ghana in a home that lacked running water and electricity. As a preteen, he was selected to join the Right to Dream Academy where he combined academic studies with football training.
Ian Patrick Pilcher (born March 21, 2003) is an American professional soccer player who plays for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC.

Jacob Daniel Jackson (born April 25, 2000) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Monterey Bay FC in the USL Championship on loan from Major League Soccer club San Diego FC.

Jeppe Theis Tverskov (Danish pronunciation: ; born 12 March 1993) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a centre back for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC. Born in Copenhagen, Tverskov started playing football at the age of three at Boldklubben 1903 (B 1903).

Kieran Sargeant is a 22-year-old American professional soccer player who plays as a left-back for San Diego FC in Major League Soccer (MLS). Born on 15 May 2003 in Houston, Texas, he stands 1.83 metres tall and wears the number 5 shirt. He officially joined San Diego FC ahead of their inaugural season in late 2025.

Leo Duru (Leonard Chibueze Duru) is a 21-year-old professional soccer player who plays as a right-back for the English club Carlisle United. Born in Manchester, England, he holds dual citizenship and represents the United States at the U-20 international level.

Manu Duah (born 5 June 2005) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC. A Generation Adidas player, he was selected with the No. 1 overall pick in the 2025 MLS SuperDraft.
Marcus Højriis Ingvartsen (born 4 January 1996) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC and the Denmark national team.

Michael Anthony Varas (born December 7, 1982) is an American soccer coach who is the head coach of Major League Soccer club San Diego FC. He was formerly an assistant coach with the United States men's national team and briefly served as its interim head coach in 2024.

Onni Johannes Simonpoika Valakari (born 18 August 1999) is a Finnish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC, on loan from Pafos, and the Finland national team.
Oscar Anthony Verhoeven (born May 31, 2006) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a right-back for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC, on loan from the San Jose Earthquakes.
Osvald Gabriel Søe (born 5 November 2005) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a defender for San Diego FC.

Pablo Eduardo Sisniega Fink (born 7 July 1995) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC. After spending time with Real Sociedad, Sisniega joined Major League Soccer side Los Angeles FC on 18 February 2019.
Pedro J. Soma (born June 30, 2006) is an American professional soccer player currently playing as a defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC.
William "Willy" Kumado (born 16 October 2002) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC.
